lines: Aapki site pe har dhalai mein kitni ply kharab hoti hai?
Log kehte hain: PP mehnga padta hai. Sach: ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai, sahi handling ke saath.
Sahi nailing ke liye sharp bit use kijiye taaki sheet ki life lambi chale.
Bina kisi jhanjhat ke asani se kat jati hai ye sheet
Har slab par purani ply badalna hai ya ek baar VAJRA lagana hai? Reply karo.
Chhota tukda khud check karo site par, sirf delivery charge do, reply karo SAMPLE
Aapki site par har dhalai mein kitni ply waste hoti hai?
Log kehte hain: plastic sheet kamzor hoti hai. Sach: VAJRA sheet site ki maar jhel leti hai.
Slab ki dhalai se pehle oil lagane se concrete chipkta nahi hai.
Aaj site par column ki casting ke liye taiyar hai solid VAJRA sheet.
Column ki smooth finish ke liye ply ya PP? Reply karo?
Quality khud apni site par check karne ke liye message mein SAMPLE likhiye
Har naye floor ke liye kitni ply kharidni padti hai?
Log kehte hain: plastic sheet waterproof nahi hoti. Sach: pani me bhi kharab nahi hoti.
Sheet ko seedha zameen pe na ghaseeto, utha ke rakho: zyada chalegi.
Patli aur halki lagne wali ye sheet site par poori taqat deti hai.
Column ki casting ke liye purani ply ya solid VAJRA sheet? Reply karo?
Site par khud quality check karne ke liye 1x1 ft sample mangwayiye, reply karo SAMPLE.
Aapki site par kitni ply waste ho rahi hai?
Log kehte hain plastic formwork mud jaata hai. Sach: VAJRA heavy site load araam se uthati hai.
